children: cut its price targets on Dell Technologies
but still named both its top IT hardware picks ahead of earnings.
Analyst Asiya Merchant kept Buy ratings, lowering Dell's target to $550 from $600 and HPE's to $80 from $92. Those levels imply gains of about 70% and nearly 74%, respectively.

Citi pointed to its quarterly survey of chief information officers, checks with resellers and upbeat comments from Cisco (CSCO), Arista Networks (ANET) and CDW (CDW), which suggest a broad upgrade cycle in business IT.
Demand for AI infrastructure also remains strong, the bank said, though it flagged worries about peak AI demand and weaker PC sales.
Dell shares have dropped more than 30% in three months, a level Citi views as attractive.

title: Citi Bank Slashes Dell And HPE Price Targets Ahead Of Earnings
